firmwareNotes: Silent original WebGL2 instrument on the paired Mac screen. No audio or notes. Its renderer publishes a capability manifest (packages/vsynth/src/manifest.ts): the CCs below on channel 1 (values 0-127) and program changes 0-3 (Flow, Rings, Prism, Water). CC21 switches to Water and sets ripple depth, so forward/back hand motion makes expanding ripple waves. Verification is visual: the headset camera, backed by the renderer's own receipt.

usb.notes: Virtual MIDI-style output in the paired companion or simulated room; no USB permission required.

channels.receive: Channel 1. CC values 0-127. Program change 0-2 selects Flow, Rings, Prism. CC21 selects Water ripples and controls ripple depth. CC120/121/123 or panic resets all parameters and animation phase.

demo.visualFeedback: Camera compares the laptop screen's luma and colour before and after commands.
